text:
maria: Heads up — sudden spike in duplicate series hitting remote_write from us-west exporters. p95 rw latency jumped from 120ms -> 950ms, cortex-sidecar write_queue depth x3. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/PA9/prometheus-overview (link)
ashok: looking at exporter logs now, seeing a bunch of conn resets and repeated labels being attached. sample log:
```
level=error ts=2024-11-12T17:45:06Z component=remote write err=\"Post \\\"http://cortex-ingest:443/api/v1/push\\\"\": read tcp 10.0.5.12:54012->10.1.2.3:443: connection reset by peer
```
ashok: also noticed metric churn where same metric name has variations like pod=app-1, pod=k8s/app-1, pod=app-1-legacy — looks like a relabel/annotation explosion from a recent ksm update
maria: that matches an alert we got: alertmanager flagged remote_write_queue_growth for cluster-us-west-2
maria: can someone grep for `pod_ip` and `container_id` labels in the last 1h? I suspect we're not dropping ephemeral labels
ashok: quick grep shows ~120k series tagged with pod_ip in the scrape window vs ~3k usual. pod_ip added by an annotation-relabeller in the kubelet-exporter config.
tom: I pushed a quick diagnostic PR to staging with a metric_relabel_configs drop; PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/345 — it drops pod_ip and container_id at scrape. snippet:
```
metric_relabel_configs:
- action: labeldrop
  regex: pod_ip|container_id
```
jess: good quick mitigation. Long-term we need to fix the relabeller that transforms k8s annotations into labels — looks like the mapping changed and started copying annotations into multiple label names. Also we should add a rule to collapse pod name variants.
ashok: suggestion: use a replace relabel to normalize pod names and then labeldrop the raw annotations. e.g.
```
relabel_configs:
- source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
  regex: "(.*)-[0-9a-f]{5,}$"
  target_label: pod
  replacement: "$1"
  action: replace
- action: labeldrop
  regex: "annotation_.*|pod_ip|container_id"
```
tom: another immediate throttle knob: reduce remote_write batch size so cortex doesn't get overwhelmed. In the prometheus `remote_write` config we can set `queue_config.max_samples_per_send: 2000` and `max_shards: 1` for this scrape job while we fix labels.
jess: +1. Also let's adjust retention/ttl rules on the receiving side to avoid keeping duplicate series long-term — add a dedupe policy in the ingesters for short-lived dupes.
ops-bot: deploy status: rolled out infra PR 345 to staging at 17:58 UTC, canary pass green.
maria: plan — (1) merge quick drop PR to prod for us-west exporters, (2) patch relabeller mapping in kube-state-metrics config, (3) create an alert suppression rule to avoid alert spam while queues drain, (4) follow up with a postmortem and cost estimate for increased remote_write egress during the spike.
tom: I opened prod PR #555 to apply the metric_relabel drop to the us-west scrape job.
ashok: I'll add a Grafana panel showing label-cardinality by label key to detect future anomalies earlier.
jess: reminder: add a test to infra repo that fails CI if pod_ip or container_id end up as metric labels for kube exporters.
maria: thanks — assigning follow-ups: ashok -> relabeller fix + dashboard, tom -> prod PR + runtime throttle change, jess -> CI test + retention change, i'll draft the postmortem template. :thumbsup:
